title: Prior Authorization Turnaround Standards: Days Added by a Member-Requested Deadline Extension
content:
**Turnaround rule.** Under Prior Authorization, the days a member-requested deadline extension adds to a request's decision deadline are ten (10) days for the member to obtain the prior plan's papers plus the class's decision-notice mailing business days counted as calendar days. The total is never more than the class's most review-extension days and never fewer than one day.

## Parts of the figure

| Part | Figure |
|---|---|
| Days for the member to obtain the prior plan's papers | 10 calendar days |
| Mailing days | the class's decision-notice mailing business days, each counted as one calendar day |
| Upper limit | the class's most review-extension days |
| Lower limit | 1 day |

The ten days and the mailing days are added together first; the upper and the lower limits then apply to the total.

## Worked figures (hypothetical class figures)

| Case | Mailing business days | Most review-extension days | Ten plus mailing days | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3 | 14 | 13 | 13 |
| B | 5 | 14 | 15 | 14 (upper limit) |
| C | 3 | 8 | 13 | 8 (upper limit) |

In case A, ten days plus three mailing days gives 13 days, which is inside the limit of 14, so the deadline moves by 13 calendar days.
